value.rationale: The complete exact natural unit-orbit distribution for an infinite family of finite noncommutative local rings is paired with a sharp information-loss theorem: on F32 two rings neither isomorphic nor antiisomorphic share the entire conjugacy size spectrum, nonzero zero-divisor graph and commuting probability. This is motivated by recovering finite-ring structure from conjugacy and zero-divisor invariants.
